title: Created limits, colimits and abelian structure on fixed pairs
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal V$. Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with $\mathcal V$-small morphism sets and all $\mathcal V$-small limits and colimits, and let $T:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ be an additive autoequivalence. Let $\mathcal B=\mathcal A^T$ be the fixed-pair category and $U:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ its forgetful functor [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Then $\mathcal B$ is abelian, with addition of morphisms inherited from $\mathcal A$, and $U$ creates all $\mathcal V$-small limits and colimits. More precisely, for a small diagram $(X_i,\theta_i)$, its limit has carrier $V=\lim_iX_i$ and structure $TV\cong\lim_iTX_i\xrightarrow{\lim_i\theta_i}V$; its colimit has carrier $W=\operatorname{colim}_iX_i$ and structure $TW\cong\operatorname{colim}_iTX_i\xrightarrow{\operatorname{colim}_i\theta_i}W$. The projections, respectively coprojections, with these structures form universal cones, respectively cocones, in $\mathcal B$. In particular zero objects, finite biproducts, kernels and cokernels have their underlying constructions in $\mathcal A$. A morphism in $\mathcal B$ is monic, epic, or invertible if and only if its underlying morphism has that property. The underlying inverse of an invertible commuting morphism is a commuting morphism. Thus $U$ is additive, faithful, exact and conservative, and reflects exactness of sequences.

proof.text: Use the existing IsoAlgebra preadditive, additive-forgetful, faithful and reflects-isomorphisms instances for the fixed-pair category [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. The existing IsoAlgebra.abelian instance supplies the abelian structure [def-sp-abelian], since the autoequivalence preserves finite limits and colimits by [lem-galois-equivalence-preserves-limits]. Its finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation instances give preservation of finite biproducts. Functor.map_add identifies inherited addition on carriers.

For an arbitrary limiting cone c of the underlying diagram D, define alpha to be IsLimit.conePointsIsoOfNatIso for the T-image cone and c, using the structure natural isomorphism. The T-image cone is limiting by [lem-galois-equivalence-preserves-limits]. Its projection formula makes every c.π_j an intertwining morphism [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. For every fixed-pair cone s, lift its carrier cone using c; after composing with each c.π_j, the required intertwining square reduces to the square for s.π_j. The limit hom-ext principle proves the square. Faithfulness transfers factorization and uniqueness, giving a lifted limiting cone with exactly the stipulated carrier and projections, including for an empty diagram. Apply createsLimitOfReflectsIso to these lifts to obtain creation of all limits of the specified size.

Dually, for an arbitrary colimiting cocone c define alpha by IsColimit.coconePointsIsoOfNatIso for the T-image cocone and c. Its coprojection equation makes the ambient coprojections intertwine [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Descend every carrier cocone through c; test the intertwining square on T of each coprojection. The preserved colimit [lem-galois-equivalence-preserves-limits] gives hom-ext, reducing the square to that of each input coprojection. Faithfulness transfers the universal property. These lifts have the exact displayed comparison structure and original carrier coprojections, even for the empty diagram. Apply createsColimitOfReflectsIso to obtain creation of all colimits of the specified size.

For every fixed-pair morphism, the existing finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation of the forgetful functor preserve monos and epis; faithfulness reflects them. Reflection of isomorphisms gives the isomorphism equivalence. For the explicit inverse square, postcompose both proposed maps with the invertible carrier f, replace theta_X followed by f using its intertwining equation [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category], and simplify T(inv f) followed by T(f) to the identity. Finally apply ShortComplex.exact_map_iff_of_faithful: the abelian structure [def-sp-abelian] supplies homology, and the additive exact forgetful functor preserves left and right homology and faithfully reflects vanishing.

lean.statement: theorem fixedPairCreatedAbelianStructure {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [LocallySmall.{w} A] [HasLimitsOfSize.{w, w} A] [HasColimitsOfSize.{w, w} A] (T : A ⥤ A) [T.Additive] [T.IsEquivalence] : Nonempty (Abelian (IsoAlgebra T)) ∧ (∀ (X Y : IsoAlgebra T) (f g : X ⟶ Y), (f + g).hom.f = f.hom.f + g.hom.f) ∧ Nonempty (CreatesLimitsOfSize.{w, w} (forget T)) ∧ Nonempty (CreatesColimitsOfSize.{w, w} (forget T)) ∧ (∀ (J : Type w) [Category.{w} J] (D : J ⥤ IsoAlgebra T) (c : Cone (D ⋙ forget T)) (t : IsLimit c), ∃ (α : T.obj c.pt ≅ c.pt) (π : (Functor.const J).obj (mk c.pt α) ⟶ D), α = IsLimit.conePointsIsoOfNatIso (isLimitOfPreserves T t) t (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft D (strNatIso T)) ∧ (∀ j : J, (π.app j).hom.f = c.π.app j) ∧ Nonempty (IsLimit (Cone.mk (mk c.pt α) π))) ∧ (∀ (J : Type w) [Category.{w} J] (D : J ⥤ IsoAlgebra T) (c : Cocone (D ⋙ forget T)) (t : IsColimit c), ∃ (α : T.obj c.pt ≅ c.pt) (ι : D ⟶ (Functor.const J).obj (mk c.pt α)), α = IsColimit.coconePointsIsoOfNatIso (isColimitOfPreserves T t) t (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft D (strNatIso T)) ∧ (∀ j : J, (ι.app j).hom.f = c.ι.app j) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (mk c.pt α) ι))) ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits (forget T) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (forget T) ∧ PreservesFiniteBiproducts (forget T) ∧ (∀ (X Y : IsoAlgebra T) (f : X ⟶ Y), (Mono f ↔ Mono ((forget T).map f)) ∧ (Epi f ↔ Epi ((forget T).map f)) ∧ (IsIso f ↔ IsIso ((forget T).map f))) ∧ (∀ (X Y : IsoAlgebra T) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso ((forget T).map f)], T.map (inv ((forget T).map f)) ≫ X.str.hom = Y.str.hom ≫ inv ((forget T).map f)) ∧ (forget T).Additive ∧ (forget T).Faithful ∧ (forget T).ReflectsIsomorphisms ∧ (∀ S : ShortComplex (IsoAlgebra T), (S.map (forget T)).Exact ↔ S.Exact)
